system.description: Decanting up to one Blood Trait into a container and passing your hands over it with ash and crushed ginger cleanses that vitae of poison, disease, or rot, though it does nothing to change its potency or ability to cause a blood bond. The ritual only works on blood already removed from a body, not blood still coursing in a living vessel.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
